tasks.description: Analyze the ambient temperature measurements over time to identify diurnal temperature patterns, detect anomalies, and track temperature fluctuations.
Examine the relationship between ambient temperature and surface temperature to understand the thermal dynamics of the local environment.
Analyze the solar radiation data to estimate daily and seasonal solar exposure cycles, and evaluate the impact of cloud cover on radiation levels.
Track the relative humidity levels over time and identify any correlations with other environmental factors, such as temperature and precipitation.
Examine the soil moisture and watermark data to understand the local hydrology, monitor soil drying trends, and identify potential water stress events.
Calculate the wind speed and direction to profile the local wind patterns, detect wind gusts, and identify potential wind-related hazards.
